in_hindi.name: व्रजेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: व्रज (Vraja) - वन (van) - forest, ईश (Ish) - देव (dev) - God

in_marathi.name: Vrajesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Vraja
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vrajesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Name derived from Vraja, a place in India. Vrajesh is a name of Lord Krishna, who is believed to have spent his childhood in Vraja. Vrajesh is a revered name in Hindu mythology, representing love, joy, and spiritual growth.

vedic_reference.note: Vrajesh is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'व्रज' (Vraja), which refers to the abode of Lord Vishnu. In Hindu mythology, Vraja is the birthplace of Lord Krishna and is considered to be a sacred place where the divine presence of Lord Vishnu is always present.
